name: Elijah
summary: A prophet from Gilead who stood alone against King Ahab and the prophets of Baal. At the end, a fiery chariot parted him from Elisha and a whirlwind took him up into heaven.

key_moments.title: Announces a Drought to Ahab
key_moments.description: Elijah told King Ahab there would be no dew or rain except by his word, then hid by the brook Cherith, where ravens fed him.

key_moments.title: Raises the Widow's Son
key_moments.description: At Zarephath a widow's flour and oil never ran out while she fed Elijah. When her son stopped breathing, Elijah cried to the LORD, and the child came back to life.

key_moments.title: Calls Down Fire on Mount Carmel
key_moments.description: Elijah challenged the prophets of Baal to call down fire on a sacrifice. Their god never answered; the LORD sent fire that burned up Elijah's soaked offering, and the people cried that the LORD is God.

key_moments.title: Hears a Still Small Voice
key_moments.description: Fleeing from Jezebel, Elijah walked forty days to Horeb, God's mountain. Wind, an earthquake and fire passed by, yet the LORD was in none of them; after them came a voice, still and small.

key_moments.title: Taken Up in a Whirlwind
key_moments.description: As Elijah and Elisha walked and talked beyond the Jordan, fiery horses and a fiery chariot came between them, and a whirlwind carried Elijah up into heaven.
